name: Headers
purpose: App-only header components that title and frame a screen or section. Three types: Header Content (a row with an optional action), Header Section Titles (a small section label, optionally with an index and amount), and Headers Display (a large display header with optional image and a processing state).
$family: Covers the Headers family (app only); each type is a separate Figma component.

variants.name: display
variants.use: Large display header (font-1) with optional image; has a processing state.
